physicalNotes: Radius: the 10.18 mas limb-darkened diameter of Montargès et al. (2018, A&A 614, A12) at the Gaia DR3 distance of 657.6 pc; 720 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius (the paper's 593 solar radii use the Hipparcos 549 pc). GM from the current mass of 14.37 solar masses in the paper's stellar parameters (CDS J/A+A/614/A12), times the JPL solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. presentationUp: the star has no measured axis, so the presentation frame puts the display axis (celestial north at the star) up.
